newsitem.title: FRANCE: Daewoo says Thomson recap cost 10 bln Fr.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo says Thomson recap cost 10 bln Fr.

text.p: Daewoo Electronics Co Ltd's chairman and chief executive officer Bae Soon-Hoon said on Thursday that the immediate cost for Daewoo of taking over and recapitalising Thomson Multimedia would be in the region of 10 billion francs.
"The immediate cost of acquiring and Thomson Multimedia and recapitalising it will amount to around 10 billion francs for Daewoo," Bae was quoted as saying in newspaper La Tribune Desfosses.
"But this 10 billion will only be the first stage. We have a plan for a worldwide investment of 13 billion francs, of which five billion will be for France," he told the newspaper.
Bae also said he was surprised by the outcry in France over the privatisation of parent Thomson and the plan for the Thomson Multimedia unit to go to the South Korean firm.

"I am very surprised by the criticism and a little disappointed at the degree to which the attention has focused on out being Korean rather than being an industrial group which invests long term," he said.
"Daewoo alone can ensure a lasting recovery of Thomson Multimedia's competitiveness and profitability."
